metrics_unit: fractions in summary groups; percent in CSV/condition rows
primary: exact support, extra/missing terms, per-true-coefficient errors
secondary: maximum condition mean of three full-horizon prediction errors

target_protocol.metric: maximum across condition means of final-trajectory relative L2; exclude initial frame
target_protocol.failure_action: target not achieved; retain failed condition
target_protocol.conditioning: observed prefix before forecast start; 11 full or 6 coarse frames

coefficient_protocol.primary_metrics: exact support, extra/missing terms, each true coefficient error
coefficient_protocol.ac_metric: maximum true-term relative coefficient error across all ten AC conditions
coefficient_protocol.zero_baseline_error: relative improvement not demonstrable; gain check fails

retrospective_diagnostic.prediction_scope: development RMSE only; no final prediction score
